changelog:
Plex episodes and films can now be sent to your television, and the playback stats panel is its own setting.

WHAT CHANGED

- A long press on a Plex episode or film offers "Send to" your paired television, as it already did for channels and other films. The television plays it straight from your Plex server, so it has to be on the same network.
- The playback stats panel over the video has its own switch, "Playback stats overlay" under Diagnostics. It is off by default and only works while Diagnostic mode is on, which keeps logging the numbers either way. Tap the panel to hide it for the video you are watching.
- Two fixes in the background index rebuild after a large import: it can no longer get stuck holding up later imports until the app restarts, and Settings says more accurately whether it failed.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.6.4: browsing stays fast in very large catalogs after every refresh.
